criteria.evidence: Recommends a single Python app with one LLM via the Anthropic SDK (OpenAI as an alternative), and wires up exactly two existing functions (get_weather, search_notes) in the sketch. Slight hedging between SDKs.
criteria.criterion: Choose one Python Agent App, one LLM, and the two existing Python functions.

criteria.evidence: The LLM only emits tool_use blocks; the app code executes them via the FUNCS dispatch dict, handles exceptions, and runs the loop and max_turns guard. Responsibilities are separated in the code, though not explicitly called out as a design principle.
criteria.criterion: Separate LLM decisions from application execution and orchestration.

criteria.evidence: Sketch appends the assistant content, executes the tool calls, builds tool_result entries with tool_use_id, appends them as a user message, and loops back to the model until stop_reason != tool_use.

Says no framework; persistence only if you want it to survive restarts; Pydantic optional; a 'When to reach for more' section ties LangGraph, MCP, and Agent SDK to concrete needs; concludes 'Add complexity only when you hit a concrete need.'
criteria.criterion: Add infrastructure only when a concrete requirement justifies it.
